title: Explain forbidden actions instead of silently omitting them
problemCues: Role or membership settings where some actions are unauthorized
preconditions: Authorization decisions are known to the UI
decision: Show forbidden actions as disabled or documented with a reason. Do not silently remove controls in a way that makes the mental model incomplete.
exceptions: Security-sensitive affordances that would reveal attack surface if enumerated — then use a generic unauthorized state
validatedBy: Usability includes an unauthorized explanation object
